name: A4U LIC Calculator
changelog:
4.2.0

  • New in the calculator: Jeevan Raksha (894) term plan — male/female, smoker/non-smoker, regular or limited (10/15 years) premium, high Sum Assured rebate as per the LIC brochure
  • Bima Platinum (770): premium matches all 20 sample premiums in the LIC brochure; correct half-yearly, quarterly and monthly factors; higher guaranteed additions for high Sum Assured
  • Term plans show life cover and cover-till age instead of maturity, on screen and in the PDF

4.1.0

  • New in the calculator: Bima Platinum (770) with guaranteed additions, yearly income, booster and surrender value
  • Fix: policy loan during the premium paying term now uses the brochure limit (75%, or 90% for Bima Jyoti) instead of 40%
  • The PDF now uses the same new charts as the screen (timeline, money in and out, policy value)
  • Faster pages: LIC rate tables load only for the plan you pick; branch search runs on the server
  • Old /lic-calculator/<plan>/ pages now redirect to the new plan pages
  • Plan hub pages show only one canonical link and description even with other SEO plugins

4.0.0

  • LIC Plan Hub at /lic-plans/: a page for every current LIC plan (about 60) with eligibility, key benefits, riders, loan, tax, proposal form, FAQ and similar plans
  • Plan finder (age, plan type, search), English / Marathi / Hindi labels, plan card PDF, lead form with email and Telegram alerts
  • Exact premiums from LIC tariff rates for 11 plans; surrender value = higher of guaranteed and special surrender value; loan as per brochure rules; term rider rates by age and term
  • New plan in the calculator: Bima Jyoti (760)
  • New charts: life timeline by age, year-wise money in and out, policy value (cover, surrender value, premiums paid) with hover figures, and how the maturity adds up
  • New tools: compare plans, policy revival calculator, LIC bonus rates, branch locator (3,800+ offices), LIC online services
  • Own sitemap for all hub pages (added to Rank Math sitemap index and robots.txt)

3.2.0

  • New report-style output (like the LIC benefit illustration) on screen and in the PDF: Maturity Details, You pay vs You get, premium per day, benefit timeline
  • Benefit & Coverage Table with GA/bonus, normal and accident cover, loan and cash value (from brochure GSV factors)
  • PDF pages: Plan details & features, Premium chart, How the plan works, Why LIC, Flexi income table, advisor card with photo (English, Marathi, Hindi)
  • Data sync now applies LIC data changes automatically, with one-click Undo
  • Plan 883: actual LIC quote point added

3.1.2

  • Fully automatic updates: WordPress installs new versions of this plugin by itself
  • Cache is cleared automatically after each update

3.1.1

  • New plans: New Money Back 20 Years (720), New Money Back 25 Years (721), New Children's Money Back (732)
  • Money-back schedule shown year by year in the result and the PDF (English, Marathi, Hindi)
  • All 12 sample premiums from the LIC brochures reproduce exactly
  • Help-me-choose wizard now suggests 732 for child goals and 720 for savings

3.1.0

  • Ready Reckoner (premium by age × term) — also in the PDF
  • Product Mix: combine up to 3 plans with total premium, benefits and combined IRR — also in the PDF
  • Help-me-choose wizard (goal, age, budget, years → 2–3 plan options and quick compare)
  • Saved proposals for advisors (stored only on the advisor's device)
  • PDF: 6 cover images + your own image, Hindi language, Illustration ID in footer (admin log under Stats)
  • Offline calculator: one HTML file that works without internet (advisor only)
  • Fix: preview was skipping every second page
